text:
rachel (eng-platform): Heads up  EU telemetry recompute backlog climbed to ~28k after the CDN replay spikes. Thinking we need a short-lived "urgency" path to surface hot slices.
marc (eng-sre): Seeing worker churn on replayer group B. Preemption events spiking when we nudge concurrency.
tom (eng-platform): Can we add an `urgency` enum to /recompute API (low, normal, urgent) so ops + console can opt in?
will (eng-runtime): Adding param is trivial, but runtime must map `urgent` -> route to preemptible-dedicated pool + bump leases. Need safety caps.
grace (eng-platform): UI: console should show an impact preview if `urgent` is selected. People misuse brute-force toggles.
anika (product): Product OK if we limit `urgent` to >1h throttled windows and require 2-step confirmation. Also require a customer-impact checklist.
rachel (eng-platform): Proposal: implement `urgency` param, default normal. `urgent` triggers fractional reslice (top 20% by event-rate) + preemptible-dedicated routing + quota override token for 30m.
marc (eng-sre): Strong safety asks: 1) token lease cap 240s, 2) abort if worker-err > 0.75%, 3) heartbeat fallback to best-effort.
tom (eng-platform): I'll draft the API patch: POST /recompute {dataset, start_ts, end_ts, urgency:"urgent"}. Backwards compatible.
will (eng-runtime): I'll make routing change to honor urgency tag. If dedicated rejects, route to `replay-spot` with concurrency halved.
grace (eng-platform): Console flow: modal shows estimated slices, affected tenants (top 50 by volume), estimated token cost, and a required checkbox: "I have notified stakeholders." No default check.
anika (product): Also surface SLO-owned tenants in red and auto-suggest excluding them unless override checked with reason.
rachel (eng-platform): Operational runbook additions: snapshot queue state, enable debug for first 10 slices, set circuit-breaker at 1% error.
replay-bot: dry-run preview ready  total slices=27,843; top-20% selected=5,569; est tokens=7.1M; est runtime=1h 10m @ concurrency 64.
marc (eng-sre): Preview cost looks fine. Question: will preemptible-dedicated impact live inference SLA? Need cross-check.
will (eng-runtime): Preemptible pool isolated; shouldn't impact live, but double-check routing table for any overlap.
grace (eng-platform): Also adding telemetry: extra gauge for `recompute.urgent.active` and a rollout metric to track `urgent` invocations.
tom (eng-platform): I'll open PR for API + migration and add server-side validation to only allow `urgent` for ops role or with console checkbox true.
anika (product): Approve minimal UX, but require changelog and a short KB explaining when to use `urgent`.
rachel (eng-platform): Who volunteers to own the canary run? Need runtime + SRE + product on-call.
marc (eng-sre): SRE will own canary + abort criteria. I'll be on watch.
will (eng-runtime): I'll land routing patch and add fallback. ETA 45m.
tom (eng-platform): API PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/recompute/pull/824  includes schema + validation. Feedback welcome.
grace (eng-platform): I'll wire the console modal and the preview API. ETA 90m.
anika (product): Communicate planned canary window on status page if we run.
rachel (eng-platform): Ok plan: 1) merge small API + runtime stubs in canary; 2) run dry-run preview; 3) if preview looks like bot numbers, run `urgent` canary for 30m; 4) monitor error-rate / live inference SLOs.
marc (eng-sre): Abort triggers: worker error > 0.8% OR live P50 latency increase > 10%.
grace (eng-platform): I'll add charts to the preflight modal: live-slo risk, estimated cost, top-ten tenants.
tom (eng-platform): Will add a server-side flag `allow_urgent=true` per env to avoid accidental prod rollout.
anika (product): Sounds good. Make sure KB mentions cost delta expectations (+~15% in preview).
replay-bot: canary scheduled for +20m. Dry logs will be posted to #eng-platform-canaries.
marc (eng-sre): Oncall will join. If all green after 30m, scale-out to remaining fractional slices gradually.
rachel (eng-platform): Thanks all  keep updates here. Post canary results and any console UX hiccups. :rocket:
